results.name: Desktop sidebar groups tasks and hides authentication/design destinations
Quick Log actor picker, Account 5 and Software 6 retain selective batch behavior
Template labels match rooms, account, software, power and USB tasks
Manual worklog preserves the draft across task picker and preview
Smart room preview changes current status and supports closing
Registry move and activation immediately affect the borrow picker
Damaged returns update condition history and exclude borrowing
Worklog list uses readable mobile rows, detail, edit, multiselect, delete and undo
Worklog range rejects reversed dates and calendar navigates months
Fiscal scope changes the underlying records and preserves Oct/Sep boundaries
Staff detail has six explainable metrics and Profile keeps eight minor-task axes
DL mobile defaults to agenda; evening, CEM, type and unique proctors are retained
Class timetable includes Saturday and proportional time positions through 21:00
Classroom overlap is rejected and copying semesters skips existing rows
Schedule import explicitly uses samples and validates its effective period
Reimport skips identical rows and DL samples do not reinterpret old times
Template creation updates Quick Log and custom Combo preview
Export rejection is red with a required reason, approval downloads only own rows
User role changes show before/after and require confirmation
Spreadsheet worklog import remains distinct and validates/deduplicates rows
Broadcast preview follows the draft and displays audience/reach honestly
Read/dismiss notifications update the badge and local notification center
Settings mobile uses category drilldown and restores saved local fields
Dashboard distribution and heatmap respect the same selected person
Heatmap keeps full-opacity text and mobile controls provide touch targets
Dialog keeps keyboard focus and content clears mobile navigation after scrolling
Offline blocks worklog mutations; empty/error/loading and retry remain visible
Cleanup has explicit impact preview and reversible local result
Staff sees read-only timetables, own worklogs and personal settings
Authentication pages use their own shell and never show work navigation
All thirty views fit 375, 760, 768 and 1024 pixel widths

limitations: Synthetic local UI prototype; no production writes or authentication
Import workflow uses explicit samples; no PDF/OCR extraction
CSS materials approximate the design; native Apple rendering is not claimed
